data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'frēo' (free) and 'born' (born). The name Freeborn signifies one who is born free, unencumbered, and unbound by the restrictions of society or circumstances. This name is a reminder of the spiritual freedom that comes from faith in God. The name Freeborn carries the meaning “Born free, unencumbered” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Freeborn usually hope their child will grow to embody born free, unencumbered and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of the spiritual freedom found in faith.
